title: 9 Things a Godly Man Trains at the Gym Besides His Body
caption:
A man of God takes care of his body. But the gym was never just about the body.

Every session trains something underneath: showing up without the feeling, finishing the rep you wanted to skip, keeping your eyes where they belong, asking for help before your pride drops the bar on you.

The muscle is the fruit. The man is the point.

"For while bodily training is of some value, godliness is of value in every way." 1 Timothy 4:8

Save this for your next session. Send it to your lifting partner.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #gym #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
